name: @tribunus/client — TypeScript SDK
description: Build the public TypeScript SDK wrapping the internal TribunusRuntimeClient. Semantic operations only — never expose PGlite/Valkey/DuckDB. Transport-agnostic with HTTP, WebSocket, and RPC support. Type-safe contracts from @tribunus/protocol. Idempotent operations with receipts.
purpose: Provide the governed interface for external tools, IDE plugins, desktop app surfaces, and automation scripts to interact with Tribunus runtime state.
acceptanceCriteria: Semantic operations: create project, open session, enqueue work, observe lifecycle
All operations are idempotent and produce receipts
Error handling with classified error types
No direct PGlite, Valkey, or DuckDB access ever exposed
